title: Adaptive local representations for Helmholtz Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin methods
summary: We study the selection and stable realization of local approximation spaces in Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin discretizations of the Helmholtz equation. A scaled Cauchy-trace inner product places plane waves and Fourier-Bessel functions in a common geometry: Fourier-Bessel modes are orthogonal with explicit weights, while the same weights determine the circulant spectrum of an equispaced plane-wave trace Gram matrix.
